=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- tests/test_review_autofix_review_pipeline_contract.py:11323-11394 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The new #10151 tests (`_DET_SKIP_MERGE_STEP`, `_det_skip_ensure_final_ci_function`, `test_det_skip_merge_requests_final_ci_when_no_wait_runs`, `test_det_skip_ensure_final_ci_behaviour`) are defined after `if __name__ == "__main__": raise SystemExit(main())`, so the plain `python3` runner never defines or runs them.
  WHY: ci.yml:4152, mark-stable.yml and test-and-mark-stable.yml run the file with plain `python3`, and `_plain_runner_tests()` (line 8634) collects from `globals()` when `main()` (line 8888) is called. The `deterministic_skip_ensure_final_ci` call sites, the fail-closed `library_unavailable` branch and the inline stub check therefore go untested, and the PR's Acceptance table already marks the test "unmet". Severity disagreement: gemini rated it BLOCKER and the other four rated it MAJOR, so the highest (BLOCKER, mapped to critical) is used.
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:2270-2323 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The direct-merge branch was removed with no replacement. When GitHub refuses `gh pr merge --auto` (clean status, or auto-merge not allowed), the step ends at `report_delivery="pr_open"`.
  WHY: TARGET_BRANCH is `GITHUB_REF_NAME` (line 1905) and test-and-mark-stable.yml:3709-3719 dispatches the workflow into TEST_REPO. On unprotected bases every run opens another `auto/workflow-log-analysis-report-*` PR that stays open, and deep-audit and api-redundancy are skipped (line 2447). update_workflows.yml:1551 shows that this refusal happens.
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:2272-2447 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: When the auto-merge landing wait times out, delivery stays `pr_auto_merge`, so the deep-audit and api-redundancy steps are skipped with no fallback delivery mechanism.
  WHY: Reports that are armed for auto-merge but do not land within the wait never get a deep audit.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Every call without `--auto` that targets the default branch must end up in one of three states: ... listed in the PR body with why it is exempt (a non-protected base, e.g. `stable`)."
  expected_change_site: PR description (exemption list section)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The PR body has no list of exempt direct-merge sites or reasons (it is the auto-generated test-gate summary / "Automated implementation. Closes ...#10151"). The exemptions (claude-engine-smoke.yml x3, review_autofix.yml x1, scripts/review_autofix_step_post_review_blocked_comment.sh x2, update_workflows.yml x1) appear only in `DIRECT_MERGE_EXEMPT` in tests/test_pr_sync_merge_blocked_guard.py:262-278 (glm: 262-275) and in agents.d/10151-gated-docs-route.md. The `update_workflows.yml:1552` exemption is a real synchronous merge, and its justification exists only in the test's reason string.
- requirement: "Keep the bounded landing wait, but treat a timeout as `report_delivery=pr_auto_merge_pending`, a non-error outcome." / Tests: "a landing timeout yields `pr_auto_merge_pending` and exit 0".
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml `commit_report` step delivery assignment (line 2278 / around 2278 and 2303); tests/test_workflow_log_analysis_report_pr.py
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: No hunk adds `pr_auto_merge_pending`. The step still sets `report_delivery="pr_auto_merge"`, and the tests assert `out["delivery"] == "pr_auto_merge"` (e.g. `test_report_pr_never_merges_directly`, line 727). The departure is mentioned only in agents.d/10151-gated-docs-route.md (minimax also cites a code comment at line 2274). Neither the PR body nor changelog.d/10151-gated-docs-route.md records it as an intentional deviation.
- requirement: Acceptance row "tests/test_review_autofix_review_pipeline_contract.py::test_det_skip_merge_requests_final_ci_when_no_wait_runs"; Issue Tests: "Deterministic-skip head, no security pass: ... docs-only final CI is requested".
  expected_change_site: tests/test_review_autofix_review_pipeline_contract.py, before the `if __name__ == "__main__":` guard at line 11323
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: The test exists but sits after the main() guard, so the `python3` runner used by ci.yml, mark-stable.yml and test-and-mark-stable.yml never defines or runs it. The acceptance check is not delivered in CI.
- requirement: "Static test: every non-`--auto` `gh pr merge` against the default branch in workflows and scripts is guarded or on an explicit exemption list."
  expected_change_site: tests/test_pr_sync_merge_blocked_guard.py `_direct_merge_scan_paths()` (lines 279-284 / 281-287)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The scanner globs only `.github/workflows/*.yml|yaml`, `workflow-templates/*.yml|yaml` and `scripts/**/*.sh`. Python and other non-shell files under `scripts/` are not scanned, so an unguarded direct merge there (e.g. `subprocess.run(["gh", "pr", "merge", ...])`) would escape `test_no_unguarded_direct_merge_into_the_default_branch`.
- requirement: Issue Approach §2: "Replace the inline `_pr_wait_for_required_checks` stub so the wait and arm logic matches `scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh`".
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml, inline `_pr_wait_for_required_checks` stub in the `deterministic-skip-merge` step (lines 1409-1413)
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: No hunk touches the stub. The PR touches review_autofix.yml only at lines 807-814, 1436-1456, 1523-1529 and 1583-1589. The new test asserts the stub stays, and the agents.d fragment says "The fail-closed inline `_pr_wait_for_required_checks` stub stays." The deviation is functionally covered (scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:1490-1494 / ~1283 `_pr_ensure_final_ci`), but the PR body does not name it as a plan deviation.
- requirement: Issue Tests: "A non-docs file in a deterministic-skip PR → full final CI, not docs-only."
  expected_change_site: tests/ (e.g. tests/test_review_autofix_review_pipeline_contract.py or tests/test_review_head_gate.py) on the deterministic-skip final-CI path
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  EVIDENCE: `test_det_skip_ensure_final_ci_behaviour` stubs `_pr_ensure_final_ci` with an echo. No new test runs the real helper with mixed docs and code files and checks that the dispatch omits `-f docs_only=true`.
- requirement: "Deep-audit and api-redundancy readers then fall back to the PR branch or the previous report, as they do today when wait expires."
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml, report-timeout handling and `deep-audit` / `api-redundancy` job conditions
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: After the wait expires, delivery is `pr_auto_merge` (lines 2278-2310). The `deep-audit` condition excludes it (line 2447) and `api-redundancy` depends on `deep-audit` (line 3116). Neither job reads the pending PR branch or the previous report, so both audits are skipped.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
